title: Iran's Army Claims Drone Strike on UAE's Al Minhad Air Base; UAE Confirms Intercept, Denies Damage
detail: Early on Monday, August 31, Iran's army said it attacked the UAE's Al Minhad Air Base near Dubai with drones, saying the strike targeted locations where US forces and helicopters were stationed and framing it as retaliation for the killing of IRGC personnel and Iranian civilians in the previous day's US strike on Larak Island. The UAE Ministry of Defence confirmed it intercepted a drone approaching from Iran over UAE territorial waters, but denied 'false media reports' of a missile attack on Al Minhad, saying its air defenses remain on a 'high state of readiness' with round-the-clock monitoring. The UAE Foreign Ministry called the incident a 'dangerous escalation' and a 'blatant violation' of its sovereignty, holding Iran 'fully responsible.' No casualties or damage were reported by either side.

title: IRGC Claims It Shot Down Another US MQ-9 Reaper Drone East of the Strait of Hormuz
detail: Iran's IRGC said its air defense units shot down a US MQ-9 Reaper drone east of the Strait of Hormuz at around 5:30 a.m. on Monday, August 31, with the aircraft crashing into the Persian Gulf. The IRGC statement described the aircraft as struck 'by missile fire from the ever-vigilant combatants of the Islamic Revolution Guards Corps' modern air defense units,' with Iranian outlets tying the intercept to a newly touted domestic mobile air-defense system. US officials have not confirmed the loss. The claim, if verified, would add to roughly 30 MQ-9 losses Iran has claimed in the region since the war began on February 28, underscoring the toll of persistent drone operations over the strait even during the recent lull in ground strikes.
